sloka: ततः सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुर्विजयहर्षिता ।अवोचद्यदि तत्तथ्यं भवेयं शरणं हि वः ।। ५.५८.९० ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sā hrīmatī bālā bharturvijayaharṣitā ।avocadyadi tattathyaṁ bhaveyaṁ śaraṇaṁ hi vaḥ ।। 5.58.90 ।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing Sita's deplorable state, her illluck and her dread, I began to worry and had no peace of mind.
